rows.statement: The platform does not report the counterparty's release attestation as invalid.
The platform reports the counterparty's release as owner-signed.
The counterparty is not on the operator's deny list.
When the operator keeps an allow list, the counterparty is on it.
No adjudication this party holds went against the counterparty in the last 180 days.
This party's own book holds a settled deal with the counterparty.
This party holds the counterparty's half of an exchange.
The counterparty's card verifies under the key that presents it.
The card's latest checkpoint is at most 7 days old.
A witness in this pack's trust roots receipted the card's latest checkpoint.
The card's key declares the controller it is bound to.
No deal with the counterparty is CONFLICTING in this party's own book.
A selection the counterparty returned to this party's own ask verifies, inclusion proofs included.
The controller the card declares is in this pack's trust roots.
The selection shows no dispute with anyone left unanswered in the last 90 days.
In the deal's band the card shows at least 10 decided deals and at most 100 per thousand did not hold.
Vouches from distinct controllers, not the counterparty's own, are counted.
The disclosed history is from the same kind of work as the proposed deal.
Collateral posted on this deal covers its amount in the deal's band unit.

source: demo copy of evidencebook-skills admission-baseline@1; placeholder thresholds, for this demo only
